X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X2, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=0)
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=200).fit(X_tr, y_tr)
print(round(clf.score(X_te, y_te), 3))   # 0.978
caption: Given the real species labels -- 97.8% accuracy on flowers it had never seen.

code:
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(X2)
print(pd.Series(km.labels_).value_counts().sort_index().tolist())
# [50, 48, 52]
print(pd.crosstab(y, km.labels_))
# species 0: found perfectly. 1 & 2: overlap a little
caption: Never saw the species column -- still found 3 groups that closely echo the real species.
